tools.name: list-wells
tools.description: FREE catalog of Rainmaker wells (001–012, 014, 015, 016): id, name, tool, origin, price_usd, description, mcp_path. Also returns catalog_url. After picking a well, open {origin}/mcp directly.

tools.name: catalog-url
tools.description: FREE helper: returns the public Rainmaker catalog.json URL (same data as list-wells, hosted on rainmaker-catalog).

tools.name: recommend-well
tools.description: Keyword-route a natural-language need to the best Rainmaker well ($0.005 USDC via x402). Returns well id, origin, tool, price_usd, mcp URL, and why. After recommend, open that origin's /mcp directly — gateway does not proxy (avoids double-charge). Free alternative: list-wells. Provided as is, with n
